inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 tanshin consolidated cash flow statement, 'Share-based payments' ¥341m (4543.T_Annual_FY2026.txt:698); no net-share-settlement tax line exists (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 throughout). SBC-zero market: 0.03% of revenue.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 purchase of treasury stock ¥1m (nil). Lumpy repurchaser: ¥30.1bn FY2025, ¥11.1bn FY2024, ¥50.1bn FY2023. Policy is a 50% total return ratio including buybacks. Flat count is a modelling convention, not something SBC funds -- SBC is immaterial so there is no dilution to offset.
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,480,559,680 issued less 5,458,187 treasury = 1,475,101,493 at 30 Jun 2026 (Q1 FY2027 tanshin), plus ~0.3m dilutive awards (diluted EPS 47.73 vs basic 47.74) = 1,475.4m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (0.03% of revenue) and there is no non-SBC issuance. Share series in Metrics.csv confirmed restated to the post-2024 split basis throughout (FY2007 shows 1,610m, i.e. already x8 for the three 2-for-1 splits of 2014/2019/2024).
inputs.net_debt_note: Bonds and borrowings ¥179,942m current + ¥209,520m non-current = ¥389,462m, less cash ¥314,633m, at 30 Jun 2026 (Q1 FY2027 tanshin balance sheet). Lease liabilities (inside 'other financial liabilities', ~¥48.6bn) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Net debt is positive, so interest income is not stripped (finance income ¥6.2bn sits below operating profit and is therefore already outside the EBITDA-based flows). 'Other non-current financial assets' of ¥74.2bn (investment securities, long-term deposits) are omitted from the bridge -- composition not disclosed in the tanshin; conservative.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the statements and the flows. 10y JGB ~1.6%; Japan ERP ~5.5%; beta ~0.8 for a defensive medical-device franchise gives a CAPM cost of equity of ~6.0%. Added ~1pp because ~80% of the flows arise in USD/EUR, where risk-free rates are 2-3pp higher, and translation volatility is real (FY2027 guidance assumes USD/JPY 155 vs FY2026 actual 151). Debt is ~10% of EV at ~1% after tax. WACC 7.0%, below the ~9% house reference for cyclical keiretsu suppliers because this is non-cyclical healthcare demand. One WACC across all three scenarios: risk is charged in the flows and weights, not in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Lease principal ¥8,011m (FY2026 CF statement line 773) plus ~¥1bn lease interest = ~¥9.0bn = 0.8% of revenue, charged via lease_cost_pct_path inside EBIT. Lease liabilities excluded from net debt. D&A path (7.8% -> 7.5%) is ex right-of-use depreciation (~0.7% of revenue) so the lease is not charged twice; total reported D&A was 8.4% of FY2026 revenue including ROU depreciation and ~¥40bn/yr amortisation of acquired intangibles.
inputs.nci_treatment: None required: profit attributable to owners equals profit for the period (no non-controlling interests on the Q1 FY2027 balance sheet).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted -- Terumo is an operating medical-device manufacturer (cardiovascular devices, hospital consumables, blood/plasma collection systems, plus OrganOx organ perfusion from FY2026). IFRS reporter, JPY millions, year ending 31 March; FY0 = FY2026 (year ended 31 Mar 2026). Owner FCF FY0 = reported FCF ¥128,889m (OCF 230,852 - capex 101,963) less SBC ¥341m = ¥128,548m; after the ¥9.0bn lease cash cost the comparable owner FCF is ~¥119.5bn (10.6% of revenue), which the component build's year-1 figure (~¥123bn, 9.9%) sits just below. CSL PLASMA (8 Oct 2026): the ~¥97.5bn charge is split into ¥72bn non-cash impairment (excluded from the flows; it reduces future D&A, not cash) and ~¥25.5bn transition/termination costs, charged as a ~2pp hit to the year-1 EBITDA margin only. The ongoing effect -- loss of CSL plasma-collection revenue as CSL migrates to Haemonetics NexSys -- is modelled as a revenue drag in year 2 (base: ~3pp off growth, i.e. ~¥30-35bn of BCT revenue rolling off) and a lower mature margin than the pre-CSL guidance implied. Year-1 growth 9.5% is the maintained FY2027 revenue guidance (¥1,239bn; includes a full year of OrganOx and a 155 USD/JPY assumption). The August OP guidance of ¥257.5bn embeds ~¥20bn of non-recurring settlement gains (Q1 note 2), which are excluded: underlying FY2027 EBITDA before CSL costs is ~27% of revenue, versus 23-26% over FY2018-FY2026; the base case matures at 26.5% rather than crediting the full guided step-up. OrganOx (¥230.6bn, Oct 2025) is already in FY0 net debt and in the FY0 revenue base (¥8.0bn partial year); its growth is inside the C&V/Organ Technologies growth path and its intangible amortisation inside da_pct. Working-capital capture is NEGATIVE (-15% of revenue change): inventories ¥341bn and receivables exceed payables ¥80bn, so growth consumes cash (FY2023-24 absorbed ~¥40bn/yr). Cash tax 25% vs FY2026 ETR 23.8% and cash taxes paid 41.6bn. Terminal cap 20x binds in base and bull at 7% WACC / 2.5% g (Gordon would be 22.8x).
inputs.fx_sensitivity_note: ~80% of revenue is non-yen. A 10% yen appreciation against USD and EUR would cut yen-translated revenue by ~8% and EBITDA by more (yen cost base in Japan). The bear growth path is the proxy for a strong-yen episode; no separate FX scenario is run.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2027 guided 9.5% decelerating to terminal; historical revenue/equity CAGRs of 11-13% include ~5-6pp/yr of yen-translation tailwind (USD/JPY ~110 in FY2021 to 151 in FY2026) that cannot be assumed to repeat
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are FY2023->FY2026 (3yr) and FY2021->FY2026 (5yr). Owner FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - lease principal (FY2021 ¥31.8bn, FY2023 ¥37.7bn, FY2026 ¥120.5bn). The FCF CAGRs are not a growth signal: FY2021 and FY2023 were working-capital troughs (OCF ¥117.5bn vs NI+D&A ¥159.6bn in FY2023), so the series rebounds off a depressed base. Owner-FCF CAGR exceeds reported-FCF CAGR only because the lease deduction was proportionally larger in the low base years. Equity CAGR (12.6-13.1%) is within 30% of revenue (11.3-13.0%) and EPS (12.5-15.7%): no divergence warning, but all three are flattered by yen depreciation (equity via translation OCI of ¥392bn in other components of equity).

base.narrative: Year 1 = FY2027 revenue guidance (+9.5%) with EBITDA margin held near FY2026's 24.0% because the ~¥25.5bn CSL transition cost (~2pp) and the exclusion of ~¥20bn of one-off settlement gains offset the guided underlying improvement. Year 2 growth halves as CSL plasma-collection revenue rolls off; margins then mature at 26.5% (between the 23-26% FY2018-26 history and the ~27% underlying FY2027 guidance). Growth decelerates from 7% to 3.5% as OrganOx, TIS/Neuro and plasma ex-CSL mature. Capex eases from the 9% capacity-build peak to 7.8%; cash tax 25%; WC consumes 15% of each year's revenue increase.

bull.narrative: FY2027 lands modestly above guidance on Q1's momentum (revenue +19.9%); CSL retains partial Rika use so the year-2 drag is ~1.5pp; the guided ~27% underlying EBITDA margin is delivered and extends to 28.5% (peer med-device level) on C&V mix, GS26 productivity and OrganOx accretion; OrganOx liver NMP scales and the kidney device adds a leg around 2030, holding growth at 8-9% through year 4.

bear.narrative: FY2027 revenue misses guidance (yen strengthens toward 140, tariffs bite); CSL loss is the first of several BCT large-customer defections to NexSys and plasma revenue shrinks for two years (year-2 growth ~1%); transition costs overrun; EBITDA margin settles at 24% as Japan NHI price cuts, input inflation and OrganOx integration spend absorb the GS26 productivity gains; growth converges to 2-3% with heavier capex for retooling the impaired US plasma plants.

scenario_narratives.base: Terumo absorbs the CSL Plasma termination as a one-year cost event and a ~¥30-35bn revenue roll-off, then compounds revenue at 5-7% on Cardiac & Vascular (TIS, Neuro), plasma ex-CSL and OrganOx, with EBITDA margin maturing at 26.5%. Axes: BCT customer concentration, yen translation, GS26 margin delivery, OrganOx scale-up.
scenario_narratives.bull: Q1 FY2027 momentum carries: guided ~27% underlying margin is delivered and extended to 28.5%, CSL drag is partial, OrganOx becomes a second growth engine (liver NMP today, kidney ~2030), weak-yen translation persists.
scenario_narratives.bear: CSL is a leading indicator for BCT (other fractionators follow Haemonetics), the yen appreciates, Japan reimbursement cuts and tariffs compress margins to 24%, and growth converges to low single digits with elevated capex to redeploy the impaired US plasma capacity.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: a single-customer dependency in Blood & Cell Technologies has just been demonstrated (CSL), FY2027 reported OP guidance was cut by a third within two months of being raised, and ~80% of revenue carries yen-translation risk. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things -- full delivery of the guided margin step-up, a limited CSL contagion, and OrganOx scaling -- to go right together. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Terumo on normalised owner FCF, not on the FY2027 reported-OP guidance print: the ¥72bn impairment is non-cash and excluded, the ~¥25.5bn transition cost is charged once in year 1, and the lasting cost of CSL is a revenue roll-off and a lower mature margin than management's pre-CSL guidance implied. Leases are an operating cost (treatment B), SBC is immaterial so house and street bases coincide, and one JPY WACC of 7% is used across scenarios with risk carried in the flows and the 25/50/25 weights.
key_risks_to_valuation: Blood & Cell Technologies customer concentration: further plasma fractionator migration to Haemonetics NexSys would compound the CSL revenue loss
Yen appreciation: ~80% overseas revenue; FY2027 guidance assumes USD/JPY 155
Margin step-up not delivered: FY2027 guided underlying EBITDA ~27% vs 23-26% history; base credits 26.5%
OrganOx (¥230.6bn, debt-funded) fails to scale or its intangibles are impaired
Japan NHI biennial device price revisions and US tariffs (~¥10bn flagged)
Terminal value is capped at 20x FCF and is ~65-70% of EV; a lower exit multiple moves value materially (see sensitivity grid)
